text: (acellular component), poliomyelitis (inactivated), and Haemo- philus influenzae vaccine is used for active immunisa- tion of children. For discussion of immunisation sched- ules, see under Vaccines, p.2202. In the UK it is used as part of the recommended sched- ule for primary immunisation. It is given by intramus- cular injection in usual doses of 0.5 mL; three doses are given at intervals of one month, starting preferably at 2 months of age. Although it is not licensed for use after a child’s fourth birthday, the national schedule consid- ers it may be used up to the age of 10 years.
